# Post-Integration Exploration

## Setup

```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

theme_set(theme_classic())
```

```{r load-config}
config_path <- here::here(
  "chapter_2_sc_deconv_benchmarking", "01_sc_matrix",
  "scripts", "02_sc_integration_matrix", "config_integration.R"
)
source(config_path)
```

```{r helper-ens-to-symbol}
ens_to_label <- function(ensembl_ids, seu) {
  if ("gene_symbol" %in% colnames(seu[["RNA"]]@meta.data)) {
    sym <- setNames(seu[["RNA"]]@meta.data$gene_symbol, rownames(seu))
    out <- sym[ensembl_ids]
    out[is.na(out) | out == ""] <- ensembl_ids[is.na(out) | out == ""]
    return(unname(out))
  }
  return(ensembl_ids)
}
```

## 1. Load integrated object

```{r load-object}
seu <- readRDS(integrated_seurat_path)

cat("Dimensions:", nrow(seu), "genes x", ncol(seu), "cells\n")
cat("Datasets:", paste(unique(seu$dataset_id), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Disease groups:", paste(unique(seu$disease_group), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Reductions available:", paste(names(seu@reductions), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Metadata columns:", paste(colnames(seu@meta.data), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 2. Integration quality — batch mixing

```{r umap-batch}
p1 <- DimPlot(seu, group.by = "dataset_id",    pt.size = 0.3) + ggtitle("By dataset")
p2 <- DimPlot(seu, group.by = "disease_group", pt.size = 0.3) + ggtitle("By disease group")
p3 <- DimPlot(seu, group.by = "condition",     pt.size = 0.3) + ggtitle("By condition")

(p1 | p2) / p3
```

## 3. Cluster structure

```{r umap-clusters}
# Adjust resolution name to match what script 12 computed
DimPlot(seu, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.3) +
  ggtitle("Clusters")
```

```{r cell-counts-per-cluster}
table(Cluster = seu$seurat_clusters, Dataset = seu$dataset_id)
```

## 4. Pre-annotation labels (from per-dataset pipeline)

```{r available-annot-cols}
annot_cols <- grep("singler|celltypist", colnames(seu@meta.data), value = TRUE)
cat("Annotation columns available:", paste(annot_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r umap-singler}
if ("singler_hpca_label" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
  DimPlot(seu, group.by = "singler_hpca_label", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.2, label.size = 3) +
    ggtitle("SingleR HPCA") + NoLegend()
}
```

```{r umap-celltypist}
if ("celltypist_majority_voting" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
  DimPlot(seu, group.by = "celltypist_majority_voting", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.2, label.size = 3) +
    ggtitle("CellTypist") + NoLegend()
}
```

## 5. Label harmonisation

```{r label-agreement}
# Agreement between SingleR and CellTypist per cluster
# Adapt column names as needed
if (all(c("singler_hpca_label", "celltypist_majority_voting") %in% colnames(seu@meta.data))) {
  seu@meta.data |>
    group_by(seurat_clusters, singler_hpca_label, celltypist_majority_voting) |>
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(seurat_clusters, desc(n))
}
```

```{r assign-harmonised-label}
# After inspecting the table above, assign a harmonised label per cluster.
# Edit the mapping below:
cluster_to_label <- c(
  "0"  = "TODO",
  "1"  = "TODO"
  # add all clusters
)

seu$cell_type_harmonised <- cluster_to_label[as.character(seu$seurat_clusters)]

DimPlot(seu, group.by = "cell_type_harmonised", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE,
        pt.size = 0.2, label.size = 3) +
  ggtitle("Harmonised labels") + NoLegend()
```

## 6. Marker genes per cluster

```{r find-markers}
# Computationally expensive — run once and save
markers_path <- file.path(dirname(integrated_seurat_path), "cluster_markers.csv")

if (!file.exists(markers_path)) {
  Idents(seu) <- "seurat_clusters"
  markers <- FindAllMarkers(seu, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25,
                            logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = FALSE)
  write.csv(markers, markers_path, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  markers <- read.csv(markers_path)
}

markers |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 5) |>
  select(cluster, gene, avg_log2FC, pct.1, pct.2, p_val_adj)
```

```{r dotplot-markers}
top_markers <- markers |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 3) |>
  pull(gene) |>
  unique()

top_markers_sym <- ens_to_label(top_markers, seu)

DotPlot(seu, features = unique(top_markers_sym), group.by = "seurat_clusters") +
  RotatedAxis()
```

## 7. Known gastric cancer markers

```{r known-markers}
# Key cell-type markers for gastric cancer context
# (map to Ensembl IDs used as rownames)
gastric_markers <- list(
  Epithelial   = c("EPCAM", "CDH1", "KRT8", "KRT18"),
  Malignant    = c("TP53", "ERBB2", "CDX2", "MUC2"),    # CDX2/MUC2 = IM signature
  Fibroblast   = c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "FAP", "ACTA2"),
  Endothelial  = c("PECAM1", "VWF", "CDH5"),
  Macrophage   = c("CD68", "CD163", "MRC1"),
  T_cell       = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD8A", "CD4"),
  B_cell       = c("CD19", "MS4A1", "CD79A"),
  Plasma       = c("IGHG1", "IGHA1", "MZB1"),
  NK           = c("GNLY", "NKG7", "KLRD1"),
  Mast         = c("KIT", "CPA3", "TPSAB1")
)

for (ct in names(gastric_markers)) {
  genes <- gastric_markers[[ct]]
  # Try to find Ensembl IDs for these symbols in the object
  sym_lookup <- setNames(rownames(seu), seu[["RNA"]]@meta.data$gene_symbol)
  ens_ids <- sym_lookup[genes]
  valid  <- ens_ids[!is.na(ens_ids)]
  if (length(valid) > 0) {
    p <- FeaturePlot(seu, features = unname(valid), ncol = min(length(valid), 3),
                     pt.size = 0.1) &
           theme(legend.position = "right")
    print(patchwork::wrap_plots(p) + patchwork::plot_annotation(title = ct))
  }
}
```
